selection_metrics.mandatory_recall: matched mandatory reference findings / mandatory reference findings
selection_metrics.selected_precision: supported reportable selected findings / selected findings
selection_metrics.do_not_elevate_rate: do_not_elevate reference findings promoted to primary / do_not_elevate opportunities
selection_metrics.redundancy_adjusted_coverage: unique mandatory/secondary topic clusters covered after duplicate collapse

matching_policy.unit: semantic proposition + evidence compatibility, not wording
mandatory_conditions: supporting evidence resolves to correct analysis family
matching_policy.partial_match: allowed only for secondary scoring; never counts as full mandatory recall
matching_policy.contradiction: wrong direction, universe, treatment or causal strength

hard_failures: wrong routed universe presented as unconditional
suppressed/low-base evidence elevated contrary to study policy
